states: The left solar installation plot is empty, with the existing feeder connector waiting on the ground. The processor is positioned but unplugged and inactive. The high radio bracket is empty.

The supplied dark photovoltaic panels are deployed on simple bolted steel supports on the left plot and connected to the waiting feeder. The processor remains unplugged. The radio bracket remains empty.

Exactly the same installed array. A short power patch cable now joins the processor to the adjacent exterior distribution outlet, and its small operating indicator is lit. The repaired dish is fitted to the high bracket; dish and support only, no portable radio box.
Bare surveyed bore at left, a small capped casing hole in the ground; water processor already installed at the habitat right. No well head and no connecting hose.
The supplied cream extraction head is sealed on that same bore. No connecting hose yet.
The same well head. A plainly visible narrow service hose runs from its outlet across the ground to the processor inlet, attached at both ends. Do not add another well or processor.
The same head and same hose route. Silver foil/felt insulation wraps the entire exposed hose, leaving recognizable couplings at both endpoints.
The surveyed cave bay contains shallow loose infill and scattered manageable stones, with an obvious flat stable rock ceiling. No machinery or planted room.

Exactly the same cave and camera. The infill has been graded away to a level bare growing bay. A small spoil pile remains outside the working area. No new room, floor tiles or excavator in the painting.
A bare outdoor foundation at left awaits the solar furnace. The fixed workshop press stands at right in the open workshop threshold. No reflector or receiver yet.

The imported mirror petals stand on a simple low bolted steel support at the left foundation, forming the same solar concentrator. Its central receiver mounting point is visibly EMPTY. The press stays unchanged.

The same mirror petals and support now carry the imported cream refractory receiver and its modest tracking/control core at the central receiving point. This completes one solar furnace. The press is unchanged.
Bare level cavern floor under the same broad stable rock arch. The completed solar furnace is visible outside at the LEFT EDGE of the cave entrance, catching sunlight. No room enclosure yet.
Simple checked ceramic paving blocks now cover the intended rectangular cavern floor. The solar furnace remains unchanged. No pressure fabric yet.
A protective fabric-and-felt underlay now covers exactly that tiled floor; its padded edge is visible. No pressure envelope yet.

The cream supplied enclosure is unfolded and sealed over that same padded floor, visibly slack before pressure. Its attached teal-edged airlock and service spine are in position. It fits under the rock roof.

The SAME enclosure is inflated into a modest roomy arched pressure room under the rock. Its inner airlock door is closed and its pressure gauge shows normal pressure. The inside is empty and lamps are off.
The SAME inflated room, same airlock and floor. Supplied strip grow lights are fitted and illuminated inside, seen through the existing doorway/window. Still no beds, plants or furniture.
Empty dry occupied alcove beside the growing area; no bed or mattress. Fixed ventilation grille, a small existing shelf and the room partition remain.
A low simple bolted steel bed frame stands in the alcove. Reflective insulation is fixed under its open deck, but there is no mattress.
The same low steel bed frame carries the original plain cabin mattress, but its open underside has NO insulation.
The same bed frame has both the cabin mattress and the reflective insulation beneath the deck. Keep the same frame, exact position and same bedding.
Empty prepared growing-room floor under the installed strip lights. No bed frames or reservoir yet.

Three adjoining simple steel bed frames are installed: a deep potato bay at LEFT, a narrow soybean row across the BACK, and a shallow lettuce shelf at RIGHT. Plain straight bolted stock, no linings yet.
Those same frames now have food-safe cream liners. Their drain outlets are bare; the shared reservoir has not been fitted.
Same lined frames with drain hoses attached and their loose return ends waiting below. NO reservoir or pump yet.
Same lined frames with the one shared cream reservoir and small irrigation pump fitted beneath the beds. The drains are still unconnected, with bare outlets. No extra reservoir.

Same lined frames, now with both the shared reservoir/pump AND the attached drain hoses. One common return ends ABOVE the reservoir waterline, leaving an obvious aerating air gap. Empty growing zones, no medium, plants or nutrients drawn as coloured slime.
